name: Arcane Rhythm
description: Fuels the destructive power of your group members, allowing them to strike with Arcane Rhythm Effect III, which deals 27374 damage when they cast a damaging spell up to level 125, or a chance to strike with Arcane Rhythm Strike III, which deals 25184 damage, when making melee attacks. Lasts for 12 seconds or until you have enhanced 4 spells.
